learning_outcomes.text: Frame decisions clearly and identify the real choice to be made
Recognise and counter common cognitive biases in executive judgement
Use evidence and structured analysis proportionate to the decision
Decide well under uncertainty using probabilistic thinking
Design decision processes that improve group judgement
Balance speed and quality and know when each matters

integrative_case: An executive team must decide whether to enter a new overseas market within a quarter, under heavy uncertainty and internal disagreement: frame the real decision, counter the biases in the business case, think probabilistically with a pre-mortem, and design the meeting so the decision quality is high.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
